home_hero_haedline2: Caregivers Involved in Resilience, Community, Learning, and Education.
home_hero_paragraph: Family caregivers of people living with dementia often face complex care tasks with little to no formal training. This program is designed to provide them with the skills and confidence to care for their loved one.
home_about_paragraph: CIRCLE is a self-paced program where caregivers will participate in video training sessions, as well as interact with other caregivers in a discussion forum and dedicated virtual support community.
home_about_number_card1: Caregivers have participated in previous versions of this program.
home_about_number_card2: Caregivers reported greater confidence in providing care after completing our earlier versions of the program.
home_study_team_description: The CIRCLE project is driven by a diverse group of specialists working together to turn research into real-world solutions. I am privileged to guide this talented multidisciplinary team as we work toward our shared mission.
home_training_description: The training program will include video content and resources to help you learn and build confidence in your dementia caregiving journey.
home_cta_description: Reach out to collaborate, share ideas, or learn how we can empower caregivers and transform healthcare through training, technology, and human-centered innovation.
study_team_hero_title1: Founder of Learning Skills Together and Aprendiendo Juntos Program (Predecessor of CIRCLE)
study_team_hero_description: Dr. White is a Professor Emeritus at the UT Health San Antonio School of Nursing and the founding director of the Caring for the Caregiver program. Renowned for her "legacy of love" and advocacy in the San Antonio community, she has worked tirelessly to ensure caregivers feel seen, supported, and equipped for their journey. Moving forward, Dr. White will continue to support the team and the community as a consultant, ensuring her vision for compassionate, evidence-based care continues to thrive.
training_hero_title1: Each week, we provide you with learning materials including interactive presentations, expert video content, and reflection questions.
training_programs_subheadline: The training program will include video content and resources to help you learn and build confidence in your dementia caregiving journey.
training_unauthorized: You are not authorized to access this page.
community_description: Welcome to your safe space. Here, you can share experiences, ask questions, and connect with others who understand your journey-all within a private and secure environment.
community_connect_caregivers_description: You don't have to walk this path alone. Find and connect with others who understand the unique rewards and challenges of caregiving.
resources_description: We've gathered the most important resources so you don't have to search alone. Browse these collections to find the practical help, expert research, and community support you need right now.
footer_description1: The Caregivers Involved in Resilience, Community, Learning, and Education (CIRCLE) website was developed by faculty at the UT Health San Antonio School of Nursing, in collaboration with patients, families, and a community advisory board.
footer_description2: The information on the CIRCLE website is provided for research purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical care, and no medical advice or services are being offered.
footer_description3: This website aims to provide useful, credible, and personalized information and support for caregivers and persons living with dementia before, during, and after diagnoses. CIRCLE provides educational videos, moderated discussion forums, and links to other resources to support our research goals. CIRCLE is not responsible for information provided on external websites or linked resources.
footer_description4: If you have, or suspect you have, a health problem, you should consult your healthcare provider or physician.
footer_description5: If you are interested in participating in this program, please call 210-450-8175 or email circle@uthscsa.edu

support_section_title1: Support CIRCLE's Mission to Empower Caregivers
support_section_description: Your generous donation helps us expand caregiver resources. If you'd like to contribute, please share your email and we'll connect with you.
resources_details_description: Evidence-based care protocols and best practice recommendations from leading healthcare organizations and dementia research centers.
resources_details_mock_title: Federated Learning—A Solution for Democratizing Data for Cancer Research?
resources_details_mock_desc: Federated learning (FL) might well be the next paradigm shift in democratizing vast amounts of data from many data sources for use in cancer research. At its most basic level, FL offers a decentralized, but collective, approach to accessing, analyzing and interpreting data. Without moving any data from its place of origin ...
resources_details_mock_title_2: New Strategies for Dementia Care Management
resources_details_mock_desc_2: This resource explores updated strategies for managing dementia care, focusing on patient-centered approaches and caregiver support systems recommended by leading health organizations.
resources_details_mock_title_3: The Role of Nutrition in Cognitive Health
resources_details_mock_desc_3: Research indicates that nutrition plays a critical role in maintaining cognitive health. This guide provides practical dietary recommendations for individuals at risk of dementia.
study_team_research_team_featured_desc1: As the Principal Investigator of the CIRCLE project, I am honored to introduce you to the dedicated individuals behind our work. While we come from different backgrounds, ranging from nursing to data science, we are united by a single mission: to improve the quality of life for caregivers and patients with dementia.
study_team_research_team_featured_desc2: This team was carefully selected not just for their academic excellence, but for their genuine passion for this community. Below, you will meet the experts who are working tirelessly to turn research into real-world support for you.
study_team_research_team_member1_name: Dr. Lixin Song, PhD, RN, FAAN
study_team_research_staff_featured_desc1: As the Principal Investigator of the CIRCLE project, I am honored to introduce you to the dedicated individuals behind our work. While we come from different backgrounds, ranging from nursing to data science, we are united by a single mission: to improve the quality of life for caregivers and patients with dementia.
study_team_research_staff_featured_desc2: This team was carefully selected not just for their academic excellence, but for their genuine passion for this community. Below, you will meet the experts who are working tirelessly to turn research into real-world support for you.
study_team_system_team_featured_desc1: As the system development partner for the CIRCLE project, InNeed supports the platform's mission by transforming research insights into a reliable, accessible, and user-centered digital experience. Our role is to ensure the technology behind CIRCLE is intuitive, secure, and scalable, so caregivers and families can focus on what matters most.
study_team_system_team_featured_desc2: The system team brings together expertise in product design, engineering, accessibility, and cloud infrastructure. Beyond technical excellence, the team is committed to building inclusive, easy-to-use solutions that respond to the needs of caregivers and older adults, supporting the CIRCLE community.
community_public_description: Connect with the entire CIRCLE network. This space is open to all enrolled caregivers, allowing you to ask questions and share experiences with the widest possible group.
community_cohort_description: A dedicated space for your specific group. Posts here are visible only to the members of your assigned cohort, creating an intimate environment for closer connection.
community_feature_journey_description: Exchange experiences and practical tips with others. By sharing your path, you help build a library of wisdom for the entire community.
community_feature_moderation_description: Our team of health professionals monitors discussions to ensure a safe, respectful environment and to provide reliable information when needed.
community_feature_anonymous_description: Privacy is key. You have the option to post anonymously, allowing you to discuss sensitive topics or ask difficult questions without judgment.
resource_list_clinical_desc: Expert medical advice, symptom management tips, and care strategies to help you navigate health challenges with confidence.
resource_list_support_desc: Connect with organizations near and far. Find support groups, community centers, and advocacy networks dedicated to caregivers.
resource_list_federal_desc: Reliable information, official guidelines, and fact sheets directly from trusted government agencies.
resource_list_legal_desc: Navigate the complexities of caregiving with access to information on power of attorney, advance directives, and other legal essentials.
resource_list_publications_desc: Read the latest research, articles, and insights produced by our team to stay informed about new developments in care.
resource_list_crisis_desc: If you face a life-threatening emergency, call 911 immediately. For mental health crises or caregiver burnout, access confidential resources here.
welcome_description: Let us show you how CIRCLE supports you in developing the skills and confidence needed to care for your loved one.
testimonial_1_quote: I don’t feel as anxious as I was, you know, just a few months ago. And I think hearing from professionals who are experts in their areas, the course, has a lot to do with it. So I just feel, I think my competence is, it’s night and day.
testimonial_2_quote: It allowed to me to reflect on the care I am providing, how I have progressed. And it gave me a little more reassurance and confidence that I am doing something right and ways to improve.
testimonial_3_quote: I just feel a little more confident. You know, because I know more. And the more you know, the more confident you are and the better you are to cope with the challenges that change and present themselves every day.
testimonial_4_quote: There was so much I didn’t know in caring for my wife and this program was so helpful.
testimonial_5_quote: I knew I needed some basics so that I could extend the time that I can care for him at home. After taking this course, I knew I could do this. I’m so grateful because I can sleep a little bit better, that those stressors have lessened quite a bit.
forum_welcome_banner_title: Welcome to Cohort - 01 Community and Guideline
forum_welcome_banner_description: This community is a shared space for learning, support, and meaningful conversations. Here, you can ask questions, share experiences, and connect with others on the same journey. Please be respectful, keep discussions helpful, and avoid sharing personal or sensitive information. Our admin team is always here to guide and assist you. Let’s build a positive and supportive environment together.
